referenceFunction.generalComment: According to the dataset "diesel, burned in building machine, with particle filter/MJ/CH," regulated exhaust emissions are calculated using the non-road database published by BAFU (2015) for the year 2015. Data from the Emissions Inventory Guidebook (EMEP/EEA, 2013) were used for specific exhaust emissions not covered by the non-road database. The emission factors assume that all building machines are equipped with particle filters. NMVOC speciation is modelled using the distribution shares for lorries, and noise emissions are assumed to be proportional to the fuel consumption of lorries. The consumption of lubricating oil is taken from ecoinvent v2.2. UUID: d3e55bb1-4842-45e5-811d-abab9ea5ade8
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset is based on the process "diesel, burned in building machine, with particle filter/MJ/CH". Compared to this reference process, the dataset includes only the lubricating oil used and the emissions produced during the combustion of 1 MJ of diesel fuel in an average building machine in Switzerland. The provision of the building machine itself is excluded.

technology.text: The process "diesel, burned in building machine, with particle filter/MJ/CH" has been modified to generate a dataset that considers only the emissions produced during the combustion of 1 MJ of diesel fuel in an average building machine in Switzerland.

timePeriod.text: Review of data currency scheduled after 5 years.

representativeness.extrapolations: Noise emissions and NMVOC speciation modelled based on data for lorries.
